kaikki_vikisozluk.e: جَرْجَرَ • (jarjara) Iq (non-past يُجَرْجِرُ (yujarjiru), verbal noun جَرْجَرَة (jarjara))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Reduplicated from the root ج ر ر (j r r), related to dragging; presumably borrowed from Aramaic, already in the Peshitta ܓܪܓܪܐ (gargərā), absolute state ܓܪܓܪ (gargar, “drag, sledge”), from the root ܓ ܪ ܪ related to dragging.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: جَرْجَرَ • (jarjara) Iq (non-past يُجَرْجِرُ (yujarjiru), verbal noun جَرْجَرَة (jarjara))
g: to gargle, to gurgle, to drink with such a sound, to quaff
